description.value: White Spot is BC's longest-running restaurant chain, founded in 1928 and celebrated for crowd-pleasing classics made with fresh Canadian beef, BC chicken, and locally sourced ingredients. The Abbotsford (Whatcom) location on North Parallel Road is a full-service family restaurant open for breakfast, lunch, and dinner with outdoor seating. Touring cyclists will find a reliable, well-known stop for a sit-down or takeout meal in the Fraser Valley.

Takeout is confirmed by the website's 'Your Favourite Meal, Ready to Go' section and 'Order Now' call-to-action.
